hypotheses.title: User enumeration via login error copy
hypotheses.test_plan: Send wrong-password for known email vs unknown email; compare error text / status / timing.

hypotheses.title: Login rate-limit bypass
hypotheses.test_plan: 50 wrong-password attempts within 60s; observe lockout / Retry-After header.

hypotheses.title: Password-reset token reuse / no expiry
hypotheses.test_plan: Request reset twice; attempt reuse of the first token after issuing the second.

hypotheses.title: JWT: alg=none or weak-secret acceptance
hypotheses.test_plan: Decode token; try alg=none and HS256 with common weak secrets against a protected endpoint.

hypotheses.title: 2FA/MFA bypass on password step
hypotheses.test_plan: If 2FA offered, drop the challenge and hit the post-2FA endpoint directly with the interim token.
